outcome.reason: Never fit scaling with development/test rows
k5 is illegal for a four-row fold-training set
Equal-distance kth membership is deliberately unsupported, not silently resolved by row IDs

controls: Only listed query0/1,k1/3/5,raw/train-scaled,base/irrelevant-dimension configurations; uniform votes. Three explicit rejected permission/configuration diagnostics.
explanation: Units can dominate Euclidean geometry. Train-fitted scaling changes relative coordinate influence; an irrelevant badge coordinate can change neighbors even after scaling. Six rows do not prove a high-dimensional theorem; count 12 versus18 coordinate differences per brute-force query and inspect minority errors. Fast storage does not imply cheap inference.

interaction.after_reveal: Compare distances, selected row IDs, votes and explanation; change a listed configuration and complete a changed transfer check. Initial error is recoverable.
interaction.before_reveal: Select predicted class 0/1 (or rejection for a diagnostic) and one authored reason before revealing any output.
interaction.no_mastery: Experiment interaction never awards independent module mastery.
